import html # Template for rendering a blog post. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def render_blog_post(title: str, body: str) -> str: """ Render a user‑generated blog post safely. Parameters ---------- title : str The title of the blog post. body : str The main content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A sanitized HTML string ready for display. """ # Escape user input to prevent XSS attacks safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=True) # Render the template with sanitized values return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
